piece_type: DTC TV ad “FASENRA Rachel’s Story – End card update” (US-102362)
regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.claim: “Asthma was making me miss out on things I love, like spending time with my kids. ... I was concerned about future attacks.” | “Now I’m breathing better. I haven’t had an asthma attack in a year and I’m back to the things I’ve missed.” | “Like cheering for my boys.” | “Running my shop, and spending time with friends.” | “Haven’t you missed enough?” | SUPER: “In two studies, 65% and 60% did not have an asthma attack,”
cases.context: SIROCCO (48 wk) and CALIMA (56 wk) did not achieve complete prevention of exacerbations; SUPER omits study durations. “Individual results may vary.” AQLQ(S)+12 total responder rate improved vs placebo, but studies not designed to measure individual items incl. social/emotional functioning.
cases.rationale: Implies greater and longer-term asthma control and social/emotional improvement than demonstrated; SUPER omitting durations adds to the impression.
cases.check: Judge: testimonial 'no attacks in a year' + percent-attack-free SUPER without study duration; rule: % responder SUPERs must state timeframe.

cases.cat: Major statement not in dual modality / incomplete major statement (TV)
cases.claim: [Omission/Format] hypersensitivity information included only in the SUPERs; audio omits telling HCP or getting emergency help for allergic reaction symptoms (per Patient Package Insert); SUPERs and audio not verbatim/key-term matched
cases.rationale: Fails to present major statement in dual modality and omits material information from audio.
cases.check: Rule: align audio transcript with SUPER text; flag text-only risk items and missing PPI/MG action statements.
